title: فريشفيلد: رحلة الشحن المشؤومة عبر الأطلسي
facts: The cargo steamer SS Freshfield disappeared in 1905 after leaving the coast of America.
The ship was captained by David Lawson with a twenty five strong crew.
The vessel loaded timber in Mobile and Pensacola and replenished coal in Norfolk, Virginia.
The crew refused to board the ship in Virginia because the vessel was listing and covered in ice.
A Board of Trade inquiry investigated the loss of the Freshfield starting on August twenty third, 1905.
